title: Initial host tools do not match CI versions
symptom: The global HI and Fledge versions differ from the required CI versions
trigger: Run hi --version and fledge --version at the start of the exercise
actual: The initial PATH provides HI 0.5.0 and Fledge 1.8.0; SpecSync 6.1.1 matches
impact: The first verify lane is not evidence from the exact CI toolchain

notes.text: Downloaded release-verified HI 0.8.0 and Fledge 1.7.2 into target/tmp/ci-tools for later commands; the global PATH still has the initial mismatch, and the baseline verify used the initial versions
